data.verdict: 4₁ TOTAL 3d-index CERTIFIED from the in-repo DGG source (library/arxiv-1112.5179v1/1112.5179v1.pdf, eq 4.18 read glyph-verified): the assembly is the BARE flux sum Σ_{e₂} I_Δ(m−e₂,m+e−e₂)·I_Δ(e−e₂,−e₂) with NO prefactor — it reproduces the printed anchor (4.20) I_41(1,1)=−q−q²+2q³+7q⁴+11q⁵+11q⁶+3q⁷ exactly, and the (4.19) amphichirality/Weyl symmetries hold exactly over a 7-charge battery. The prior 'assembly-not-certified' open state is RESOLVED: the 'divergent flat wing' was a truncation artifact of rebasing each tetrahedron factor to its (un-cancelled) minimum exponent; computing I_Δ at absolute degree instead makes the flux sum converge, exactly as DGG state. The earlier q^{−e₂} near-miss was eq (4.17)'s pre-U(1)-breaking prefactor mistakenly applied to (4.18). Zero-charge series I_41(0,0) = +1·q^0 -2·q^1 -3·q^2 +2·q^3 +8·q^4 +18·q^5… converges at the substrate. The certified index is annihilated by the DGG quantum A-polynomial L̂_4₁ (eq C.7) — the SAME q-difference operator whose fundamental solution W_m(q) yields the GGM Stokes matrix S⁺ (and thence A_ω), so this index face and the already-Lean-proved A_ω=3 route (QOU.QBeta.StokesQZeroDTCount via W₋₁, thm:aomega-fourone-dt-count) are descendants of one operator. This probe does NOT itself feed A_ω (that read-off goes through W_m, not the index); A_ω=3 is a separate, already-derived result. Scope-(a); no fit; no c_k wired.
